name: Jun Hikari
source:
The handsome actress that inspired Satsuki to love theatre. Hikari is brave, confident and strong, but gentle and kind. Her popularity and rising talent threatens her senior acting peers, and as a result, Hikari is subject to their bullying. In spite of this, she remains strong and loves her job. 

[Spoiler]Her true name is Izumi Hikari. She intially enlists Satsuki to be her fan manager, but after Satsuki got her dream job of being in the costumes department, Hikari eventually re-enlists her as her stylist.[/Spoiler]
